drg.description: Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections without MCC

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 63-year-old male admitted for urinary tract infection. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.57, creatinine 2.13-2.15, hemoglobin 14.4-14.6, platelets 190-196, sodium 138, wbc 6.8-7.2; vitals dbp 78-81, heart_rate 77-83, map 93-96, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-18, sbp 121-127, spo2 97-98, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Urinalysis: positive nitrites, >50 WBC/hpf; Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Urinary tract infection. Chronic kidney disease stage 3.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 2.08-2.09, hemoglobin 14.4-14.5, platelets 192-194, sodium 138, wbc 6.7-7.2; vitals dbp 78-81, heart_rate 78-82, map 93-96, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 122-127, spo2 97-98, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Urinary tract infection. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 63-year-old male, length of stay 2 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Urinary tract infection. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
